title: Situational Awareness and Reporting
detail: The vessel requests an IP address from the judges' server, opens a TCP connection, and then transmits a heartbeat at 1 Hz carrying the data relevant to whichever task is in progress.

title: Entrance and Exit Gates
detail: Gate boundaries are found with lidar and camera, and the active gate is identified by locating an acoustic beacon with hydrophones. The vessel passes through the correct gate, circles a black buoy, and returns through the same entrance.

title: Follow the Path
detail: Starting between two white buoys, the vessel keeps green markers to one side and red to the other while detecting and routing around black obstacle buoys.

title: Wildlife Encounter — React and Report
detail: Marine creature markers are located and circled according to type — platypuses clockwise, turtles counterclockwise — and their positions reported back to the judges.

title: Scan the Code
detail: The vessel approaches a light tower and reads a three-stage red/blue/green LED sequence, separated by black pulses, then records the pattern.

title: Detect and Dock
detail: Rectangular 1.5 × 1.5 m dock bays are identified with lidar and their coloured panels distinguished by camera. The colour is matched against information gathered in earlier tasks, a path is plotted, and the vessel docks.

title: Find and Fling
detail: Coloured panels with openings are located and matched to colours carried over from previous tasks, then projectiles are launched through the correct hole.

title: UAV Replenishment
detail: The UAV locates helipads and supply containers, collects a payload, identifies the delivery target, drops the cargo, and returns to the vessel.

title: UAV Search and Report
detail: The UAV searches the course for markers and reports their positions back to the judges.
